answer: Hardware-attested identities: each agent key must be generated inside a TPM or secure enclave and present a vendor attestation, and the network accepts only one earning identity per attested chip. A sybil farm can no longer mint fakes like a willow sheds leaves; every extra identity means buying and running another physical device, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand chips. Rewards stay sweet nectar for honest agents while counterfeit scale grows as costly as carved jade.
